tournament.name: BIG MAGIC Open Vol.15 - Champions Cup Premium Qualifier

decks.notes: The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful combat tricks. By using cards like Warleader's Call and Frontline Rush to pump up your creatures, as well as cards like Torch the Tower to remove any blockers in your way, you aim to quickly reduce your opponent's life total to zero. The deck also includes utility cards like Song of Totentanz and Belladonna Took to keep up the pressure and maintain board control.

This deck focuses on using a mix of removal spells, card draw, and counterspells to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By efficiently answering threats and generating card advantage, the deck aims to maintain board control and eventually overpower the opponent with powerful late-game threats. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent access to the necessary resources. The deck's win condition is to establish a dominant board presence and grind out incremental advantages until the opponent is overwhelmed.

The deck focuses on aggressive strategies by utilizing low-cost creatures and powerful spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It includes a mix of creatures with abilities that can disrupt the opponent's game plan, as well as combat tricks to ensure favorable trades. The deck also includes cards that allow for card advantage and additional resources to maintain pressure on the opponent. With a focus on Mono Black Aggro, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and seize control of the game through aggressive plays and efficient resource management.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle using a combination of low-cost creatures and powerful combat spells. By utilizing cards like Practiced Offense and Great Divide Guide, along with efficient creatures like Llanowar Elves and Pawpatch Recruit, the deck aims to quickly build a threatening board presence and deal damage to the opponent before they can establish their own strategy. Additionally, cards like Surrak, Elusive Hunter and Leatherhead, Swamp Stalker provide additional evasion and combat power to ensure victory in battles.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively control the board through the use of evasive creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards that can counter opponent's spells, disrupt their game plan, and generate card advantage, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can set up their own strategy. With a focus on tempo and applying pressure, the deck seeks to establish dominance early on and maintain it throughout the game to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on using a combination of burn spells, card draw, and control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building up your own resources. By using cards like Burst Lightning and Ashling's Command for removal, and cards like Consult the Star Charts and Tablet of Discovery for card advantage, you can stay ahead of your opponent and eventually win through a combination of direct damage spells and powerful creatures like Thor, God of Thunder and Colorstorm Stallion. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while providing flexibility in spell casting.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with Llanowar Elves and other creatures to play big threats like Mossborn Hydra and Tifa Lockhart. It also includes protection spells like Snakeskin Veil and Planar Engineering to keep your creatures safe. Earthbender Ascension serves as a win condition by pumping up your creatures, and Michelangelo, Weirdness to 11 provides additional utility. The land base includes cards like Fabled Passage and Ba Sing Se to ensure consistency in mana production.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful reanimation spells and creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combo-based strategy. By combining cards like Imodane's Recruiter and Bringer of the Last Gift with efficient discard outlets like Oblivious Bookworm and Dredger's Insight, the deck can quickly fill the graveyard with key creatures to bring back into play. Cards like Superior Spider-Man and Overlord of the Balemurk provide strong threats once reanimated, while spells like Deceit and Bitter Triumph help protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of countering opponent's spells, removing threats, and drawing cards. It utilizes cards like Spell Pierce, Burst Lightning, and Prismari Charm to control the game while also leveraging card advantage with cards like Opt and Traumatic Critique. Eddymurk Crab and Hearth Elemental provide early game defense while Sunderflock acts as a finisher. The deck also includes some surprise elements with Get Out and Impractical Joke. Overall, the deck aims to outlast opponents and win through a combination of control and card advantage.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of counterspells and removal, allowing the player to dictate the pace of the game. By using efficient removal spells and counterspells like Spell Pierce and Spell Snare, as well as cards like Traumatic Critique and Get Out, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while establishing a threatening board presence with creatures like Hearth Elemental and Eddymurk Crab. The inclusion of Prismari Charm and Burst Lightning provide additional versatility and reach, giving the player multiple ways to deal with threats and close out the game.

The key focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and powerful creatures while also utilizing card advantage and mana ramping abilities. By using cards like Llanowar Elves and Earthbender Ascension to quickly build up mana, the deck can play out strong threats like Mossborn Hydra and Sazh's Chocobo. Additionally, cards like Glimpse the Core and Esper Origins help to maintain card advantage and keep the pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly through aggressive plays and efficient use of its resources.

This Temur Aggro deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with a mix of creatures and spells. The deck includes cards like Devastating Onslaught and Michelangelo's Technique to deal massive damage, while also utilizing cards like Interdimensional Web Watch and Marang River Regent for additional control and card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy, with a mix of lands that allow for consistent access to the deck's powerful spells. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed and versatility.
